readiness_contract.prepare: prepare_request(context, backup_witness, source_manifest=..., runtime_manifest=..., config=..., work_root=...) returns passed:false request.
readiness_contract.verify: validate_restore_witness(path, context, backup_witness) returns accepted witness only after matching actual execution artifacts and fresh immutable input/package checks.
readiness_contract.interpreter_binding: context.bindings.interpreter_sha256 is canonical SHA256 of the complete runtime_manifest.interpreter_files mapping (launcher plus framework runtime), not a single binary SHA.
readiness_contract.host_required_binding: Before calling restore_runner and after consuming its witness, Host must compare source_manifest and runtime_manifest to the preparation: repaired reservoir entrypoint, five original support modules, original Python path, all original package versions/files, interpreter files and pyvenv.cfg.
readiness_contract.startup_evidence: evidence.expected_restore_handles includes every top-level NPZ including historical handles; evidence.expected_startup maps each to entity/backend/tick_count/mode. The complete new-PID startup log must match and contain no restore/thermostat warnings/errors.
readiness_contract.default_cli: python -I -B restore_verifier.py --request REQUEST.json validates request and prints status:not_executed; does not create run directories or import numeric/service modules.
readiness_contract.execution_status: Not executed. Root owns release and actual invocation.
readiness_contract.work_root: Must be a fresh direct child of /Users/v/other/astrid/.runtime/mlx-upgrade/reservoir-maintenance/production-candidate-01/restore-runs
readiness_contract.scope: Private independent stopped-state copy; actual synchronous restore_all only, no service loop/listener/model imports. Backup/input/source/inventories retained; no forced termination.
readiness_contract.accepted_inference: Deterministic isolated actual restore using identical production inputs plus complete startup logs. No direct production-memory equality or mandatory production wrapper.
limitations: Only NumPy/default and stored lsm_shadow backends covered; stored MLX/CoreML handles reject.
